The '''Settlement Ruins''' are a village found south-west of the [[Wintertodt Camp]] in the [[Northern Tundras]]. The northern entrance is guarded by aggressive level-132 [[Ice wolf|ice wolves]], while the settlement itself is inhabited by [[ice giant]]s and [[ice spider]]s. The southern entrance can be accessed north of the [[Tower of Magic]].

From the appearance of the settlement and the frozen warriors found there, it is assumed the settlement was destroyed after the [[Wintertodt]] ravaged [[Great Kourend]] during the Long Winter 1,400 years ago.

Note that this is a [[multicombat area]], and can be threatening for lower level players. Be prepared to be attacked by the Level 53 Ice Giants and level 61 Ice Spiders.

==Transportation==
* [[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CIS}} and head west up the mountain to the southern entrance.
* [[Games necklace]] to the [[Wintertodt Camp]] and head south-west down the path to the northern entrance.

The south entrance route via fairy ring is recommended, to avoid spending a games necklace charge and also to avoid the ice wolves.

==Trivia==
* A lone [[standing stone]], identical to one of the standing stones that can be found north of [[Falador]], can be seen overlooking the village on a hill to the south-east.
* North of the settlement, there is a mysterious purple symbol on the ground, which vaguely resembles that of [[Zaros]]. Its origins, and its relation to the area around it, remain unknown.
[[File:Settlement Ruins mysterious symbol.png|thumb|left|The mysterious symbol found north of the settlement.]]
